project.name: Lumora competitive intel
project.description: Every piece of competitive intel Lumora's sales team has logged: analyst notes, Slack digests, battle cards, deal notes, pricing captures, loss debriefs. One fact each, word for word, with who logged it, when, the claim it makes and what it was copied from. Fictional data for the MemoryLake competitive-intel-memory demo.

claims.sso-business: SSO is on Pendrel's Business plan

question: Does Pendrel include SSO on its Business plan?

records.text: Stackwatch Brief (Aug 18): Pendrel will move SAML single sign-on off its Business plan; from September 1, SSO is Enterprise-only.
Kilnworth Foods discovery call: their IT lead needs Okta SSO. Told them Pendrel is making SSO Enterprise-only on September 1, per Stackwatch; we include it on every plan.
#compete digest: heads up, Pendrel SSO goes Enterprise-only from September 1. Lead with our included SSO in every Pendrel deal.
Pendrel battle card v4: SAML SSO is Enterprise-only at Pendrel from September 1. Lumora includes SSO on every plan. Trap question: ask what their SSO costs per seat.
Stackwatch Brief correction (Aug 25): the Pendrel change on September 1 moves SCIM user provisioning to Enterprise. SAML SSO stays on the Business plan. Our Aug 18 item was wrong.
Marisol Transit demo: used the battle card. Pendrel charges Enterprise prices for SSO, we do not. Their ops director liked that.
Ostrander Dental Group call: their IT manager had also read that Pendrel is pulling SSO from the Business plan (he reads Stackwatch). Good for us.
Pendrel public pricing page, captured Sept 16: SAML SSO is listed under Business (24 dollars per seat per month). SCIM provisioning is listed under Enterprise.
Kilnworth Foods loss debrief: lost to Pendrel. Their IT lead said our SSO point was wrong - SSO is on Pendrel Business, they checked with Pendrel. It cost us credibility on everything else.
Vantry Hotels first call: they asked about SSO for 14 properties. Went through the battle card - Pendrel SSO is Enterprise-only. Handing the account to Sam for the follow-up.
Pendrel list prices, Sept 16: Team 12 dollars, Business 24 dollars, Enterprise 41 dollars per seat per month, billed annually.
Harrowgate Clinics win debrief: they picked Lumora over Pendrel because Pendrel's mobile app has no offline mode for shift swaps.
Quillstack launched a payroll integration with Gusto in September; Pendrel still has none.
Brenmoor Retail: Pendrel offered them 20 percent off Business for a two-year term.

card_v5.text: Pendrel battle card v5: SAML SSO is on Pendrel Business (24 dollars per seat); SCIM provisioning is Enterprise-only. Do not claim Pendrel charges Enterprise for SSO. Lead with SCIM if the prospect provisions users from Okta or Azure AD.
